title: Expanded published Krillion Answers archive catalog
scope: Complete count-verified official scored lists for the public question pages enumerated by the cached archive index, excluding unavailable or inconsistent lists. Not the original complete game database.
sourceDateMeaning: Latest appearance date for the selected prompt in the cached index. Public question pages may merge older answer records; per-answer references are preserved below.

normalizedPromptDuplicates.key: name a national capital that is not its countrys largest city
prompts: Name a national capital that is not its country’s largest city
Name a national capital that is not its country's largest city

attribution: Questions, accepted answers and recorded rarity scores sourced from Krillion Answers, an independent archive of published Krillion reveals. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Krillion or Krillion Answers.
transformations: Normalized duplicate prompt spellings and selected latest metadata, retaining existing selected question identities.

Recorded index, returned and latest-source answer counts; accepted complete unpaginated public question lists even when historical merged records exceed a per-appearance index count. Verified each answer's source prompt, official tier and score.
Kept short prompt text, canonical answer, official score and tier only. Removed suggestions, unscored records, quips, prose and page code.
Discarded broad search aliases. Empty aliases arrays are intentional.
Removed only identical canonical strings with identical scores. Other normalization collisions are retained and audited separately.
limitations: Published archive scores may reflect multiple appearances of a question; they are not live Krillion grading.
The archive may contain historical entries, alternate spellings or inaccuracies. Count-complete means all published records, not every factually valid answer.
Coverage is bounded by the cached archive index, not a claim about all original Unlimited questions.
No explicit reusable dataset license was found in the archive terms; short factual fields and source attribution are retained.
